description: This file defines a Swift module for sanitizing and inspecting environment variables, primarily for security purposes. It includes data structures, constants, and functions to filter, normalize, and validate environment variable overrides, with special handling for shell wrappers and blocking certain keys based on policies.

classes.name: HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics
classes.description: A data structure representing the result of environment variable override inspection, including blocked and invalid keys.

methods.name: inspectOverrides
methods.description: Inspects given environment variable overrides and returns diagnostics about blocked and invalid keys.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variables and optional overrides, filtering out blocked keys and preparing a safe environment dictionary.
